ask_answers.question: Which units could take each of the six Halden streams under their permits?
ask_answers.summary: Every Halden stream has at least one permitted unit that meets its requirement. H1 process wastewater: Granger or Port Terrell aqueous incineration (deep well is permitted but is disposal; aqueous treatment is not an outlet for the active ingredient). H5 solids: Granger or Port Terrell. H6 scrubber water: Bayou Verde deep well, Riverbend, Newbury Works or Bayou Verde aqueous treatment.

ask_answers.question: Which of the six Halden streams meet the destruction requirement at which units, and which outlets are ruled out by it?
ask_answers.summary: Three streams carry QR-14 (H1 process wastewater, H3 expired product, H5 product-contact solids). Each meets it at incineration: Granger or Port Terrell for H1 and H5, Granger lab packs for H3. The requirement rules out Bayou Verde deep well for H1 (disposal, not destruction) and stabilization and landfill for H5; aqueous treatment is not an outlet for H1 because the active ingredient is not treatable. H2, H4 and H6 carry no requirement.
